checks.why: rustfmt --check, OS-independent so there is nothing platform-specific to prove here. macOS and Windows compile coverage lives only in build-macos-latest-*/build-windows-latest-* on push:main, same as every other check below.

clippy lints compiled code, so parakeet-cpp-sys/build.rs compiles the vendored ggml/parakeet.cpp via cmake as a side effect (CPU-only, ~25s on this box) before the lint runs. That only proves the Linux leg: this box has neither Xcode/Metal nor MSVC, so macOS and Windows compile coverage stays exclusively on push:main (build-macos-latest-*, build-windows-latest-* in ci.yml) — nothing here fakes that coverage.

checks.why: mirrors build-ubuntu-latest-static: a release build with the Vulkan backend (compile-only on this GPU-less box — shaders compile to SPIR-V via glslc, no VkInstance is ever created) plus the non-gated test suite (model-dependent integration tests skip without PARAKEET_TEST_* env). macOS and Windows builds, and the dynamic-backends (GGML_BACKEND_DL) legs, are not reproducible on this Linux box and stay push:main-only (build-macos-latest-*, build-macos-latest-dl, build-ubuntu-latest-dl, build-windows-latest-static, build-windows-latest-dl in ci.yml).
